verdict.rationale: Customer.io documents an App API used to "fetch data" outside of data-out integrations, backed by a published OpenAPI spec, and a CLI and MCP server that can read workspace data. However, nothing in the pack shows that this data includes per-person message history or delivery, open and click activity. missing for 10: documented per-person messages/activities endpoint, explicit sent/opened/clicked fields for a contact, example requests or responses, hands-on corroboration.
